metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 8 inches in Canberra, Australia during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about total rainfall in Canberra, Australia during a specific 9-day period (Jan 14-22, 2020) and whether it exceeded 8 inches. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - GPM IMERG would be appropriate for this 2. Convert the geometry to a point for Canberra, Australia 3. Sum the precipitation over the time period 4. Convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm, so 8 inches = 203.2 mm) 5. Check for data availability and valid pixels 6. Compare the total rainfall to 203.2 mm Let me structure this: - Use NASA GPM IMERG Final Precipitation data - Define Canberra geometry as a point with buffer - Filter collection by date and location - Check collection size - Sum precipitation over the period - Check for valid pixels - Convert mm to inches and compare to 8 inches - Handle edge cases (no data, no pixels, calculation errors) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const canberra = ee.Geometry.Point([149.1300, -35.2809]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Canberra const startDate = '2020-01-14'; const endDate = '2020-01-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG Final Precipitation const precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(canberra); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over the period const totalPrecip = precipCol.sum().select('precipitationCal'); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: canberra, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean precipitation in mm const meanPrecip = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: canberra, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); // Convert mm to inches const precipInches = meanPrecip / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall (mm): ${meanPrecip.toFixed(2)}`); console.log(`Total rainfall (inches): ${precipInches.toFixed(2)}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || !isFinite(meanPrecip) || precipInches === null || !isFinite(precipInches)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (precipInches > 8) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
